$comment: Test files the census lane accepts as unreachable by the hermetic gate, each with the reason
recorded so the exemption is a decision rather than an oversight. Liveness rule, enforced by
the lane: an entry whose file no longer exists, or whose file the gate can now reach, is a
stale exemption and fails the lane -- the same rule GATE-TOPOLOGY.md applies to

exempt.reason: //go:build cgo -- live Oracle tests. Compiled into the live-oracle Docker lane's test binary (docker/dev/backend.Dockerfile builds go test -c over this package); the hermetic lanes run with CGO_ENABLED=0 and must never reach it.

DEBT, measured 2026-08-08: //go:build integration && cgo is compiled NOWHERE. The hermetic integration lane excludes cgo; the live-oracle binary build (docker/dev/backend.Dockerfile:39) passes no -tags=integration, so this file is not in the compiled test binary either. Wiring it into the live lane is live-lane work outside issue #2; until then the census names it here instead of letting it hide.
Research probe kept as documentation under docs/, outside the Go module -- no lane can compile it and none should. It exists to be read.
